title: Rent Increases and Apartment Moves — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Article on rent and the apartment, Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

**1. Annual rent increase.** Rent is increased at most once in any 12-month period, and the new rent may not exceed the rent in effect by more than the annual rent increase ceiling (8.0 percent), rounded to the cent half up: the highest new rent is the rent in effect multiplied by one plus the ceiling percentage, rounded to the cent. Care level fees change only through reassessment and the published fee of the level.

**2. Written notice.** Written notice of a rent increase is mailed and recorded with the proposed rent, and the rent recorded when the increase takes effect is the proposed rent from that notice.

**3. Notice period.** A rent increase may be recorded only once the rent increase notice period (60 calendar days) has passed since written notice of the increase was mailed. Notice days are counted in calendar days from the mailing date, the mailing date being day 0, and the increase may take effect on the day the count reaches 60 or later.

**4. Status.** Rent changes and apartment changes may be recorded only while the residency is in active or notice given status.

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause "A resident may move to another assisted living apartment in the same community at their signed request while the residency is active; the new rent is the published rent of the new apartment type on the change date, effective from possession, and the apartment change fee is charged once" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rent in effect | 4285.00 |
| Highest new rent: 4285.00 multiplied by 1.08 | 4627.80 |
| A proposed rent of 4650.00 | Exceeds the ceiling |

| Notice mailed | Earliest effective day (day 60) | Day 59 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 April | 29 April — too early |

superseded_clauses: A resident may move to another assisted living apartment in the same community at their signed request while the residency is active; the new rent is apartment_base_rent of the new apartment type on the change date, effective from possession, and apartment_change_fee is charged once.
